# MCP

`client.mcps` → `/api/v1/developer/mcps` — `Mcp { transport: 'sse'|'streamable', url, authType: 'oauth'|'apiKey', authMode: 'owner'|'user' }`

```ts
const mcp = await persona.mcps.create({ name: 'Linear', transport: 'sse', url: 'https://mcp.linear.app/sse', auth:{} });
await persona.mcps.testConnection(mcp._id); // persists tools/resources
const status: McpUserConnectionStatus = await persona.mcps.oauth.getUserConnectionStatus(mcp._id); // requires externalUserId
const url = await persona.mcps.oauth.getUserAuthorizeUrl(mcp._id, '/return');
await persona.mcps.callTool(mcp._id, 'list_issues',{});
const res: McpReadResourceResult = await persona.mcps.readResource(mcp._id, 'ui://widget');
```
